arguments.request: Static game recovery. Review a documentation-only experiment recording native pinned public PS2Recomp VIF TOP latch and VU E-stop/resume behavior using authored synthetic inputs. No original guest entries, payloads, game runner, GUI or audio startup. Evidence does not establish game preceding VIF state, hardware equivalence or full runtime correctness.
claims: The native synthetic probe reports 4096 passing VIF latch cases,1024 passing packet-order cases and4096 passing VU stop/resume cases.
The E-bit-clear mutant breaks the expected first-stop boundary in all4096 VU cases, as checked by a separate probe invocation with returncode0 and empty stderr.
The probe symbol check excludes all4746 generated guest entry names and the game registration table as well as InitWindow and InitAudioDevice symbols.
The public VIF MSCNT handler latches TOP from TOPS before its DBF/BASE/OFFSET update; the VU interpreter executes the E-delay pair and leaves PC after it before resuming with updated TOP/ITOP.
